name: Doom
overview: Scripture reveals doom as the inevitable consequence of sin, described as death being the wages earned by sin, contrasted with the gift of eternal life through Jesus Christ. The Word of God is depicted as powerful and discerning, able to penetrate deeply into the human heart to reveal true intentions. Ultimately, doom is portrayed in its fullest form as eternal torment in the lake of fire reserved for the devil and his agents, underscoring the seriousness of rebellion against God and the hope found only in Christ.
